name: Toyo Eatery
address: The Alley at Karrivin, Karrivin Plaza, 2316 Chino Roces Avenue Extension, Makati - Metro Manila
dinnerNoteFil: Tasting menu, 8 kurso (may dagdag na 10% service charge)

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Indoor dining area with a full view of the kitchen; plus 10% service charge; the menu is set each day

bookingOpens: Online on TableCheck only. Each week's tables (Tuesday to Saturday) are released on a Thursday at 3pm Manila time, about three weeks ahead; for example, 20–24 October opened on 1 October. The restaurant doesn't take bookings further ahead by email or phone.

bookingWindow.note: Each Tuesday-to-Saturday week is released on the Thursday 19 days before, at 3pm Manila time.

cancellation: A deposit is taken. It is refunded in full for cancellations at least 48 hours ahead; changes to party size or date need 24 hours' notice for the deposit to be credited. No refund for guests dropped or changes on the day.
groups: Parties of 15 or more: email reservations@toyoeatery.com or text +63 917 720 8630.
